condition_module_description: The components of your customers' units: each one's condition over time on the NEN 2767 scale, from the defects the checklists find, its status, its article in the shop and its service history, and planning the critical ones.
condition_legend_critical: Condition {critical} or worse, or inspection expired — plan within {days} working days.
condition_legend_attention: Condition {attention}, a rejected inspection point or open advice — take it along at the next visit.
condition_legend_planned: Work on it is in the planning; the mark beside it says what it needs.
condition_legend_ok: Within interval and inspection valid — no action.
condition_feed_description: What happened to the units lately: orders, work orders and conditions.
condition_feed_empty: Nothing has happened to these units yet.
condition_card_description: The unit's condition on the NEN 2767 scale (the worst of its own and its components'), and how it went.
condition_record_component_description: A correction from the office: its defects give its score by NEN 2767's method. It counts until a newer condition, e.g. the next completed checklist's.
condition_record_description: Its defects give its score on the NEN 2767 scale: each element's by the norm's method, the worst element's; none is 1. It counts until the next completed checklist's; the earlier ones stay in its history.
condition_advice_placeholder: E.g. Replace the spring set (SD-001) — cycle counter above 90%.
condition_advice_description: Open advice makes the unit need attention until a newer condition says otherwise.
condition_parts_hint: Parts used are on the unit's orders.
condition_components_description: The unit's components: each one's condition, from the defects found on the checklist points that check it, its status and its article.
condition_components_none: No components yet: the unit's condition counts as a whole.
condition_component_dialog_description: A completed checklist gives the component a condition from the defects of the points that check it.
condition_component_article_description: The material whose SKU the parts shop sells: a rejected point of the component suggests it first.
condition_component_checkpoints_descript: The points of the unit's checklist that check this component. Choosing an article checks its shop points.
condition_component_no_checkpoints: The unit's category has no checklist template, so there are no points to choose.
condition_component_remove_description: Its conditions go with it; the unit's own stay.
condition_component_article_not_found: That article isn't one of your materials.
condition_component_checkpoint_not_found: Those checklist points aren't the unit's.
condition_components_max: A unit has at most {max} components.
condition_not_in_progress: Order {number} isn't in progress: conditions are recorded while the work is under way.
condition_portal_ask: The checklist is completed. Any advice on the unit?
condition_portal_computed: From the checklist: its rejected points' defects, by NEN 2767's method.
condition_portal_no_score: The checklist gave no score: none of its points counted (all not applicable).
condition_settings_description: From which condition on the NEN 2767 scale a unit is critical or needs attention, and whether critical units are planned by themselves.
condition_auto_plan_description: Each day, a critical unit without an open order gets a maintenance order, to be done within {days} working days.
condition_thresholds_order: Attention must be better (lower) than critical.
condition_banner_intro: Every customer, component, preference and activity in one place. From the first sign to the completed checklist, in one line.
condition_step_link: Every component is linked to its unit, location and customer, with its article from the parts shop.
condition_step_monitor: A condition on the NEN 2767 scale from the defects found on the checklists, and the inspections that are due.
condition_step_plan: The service interval sets the next visit; you plan the critical components straight away.
condition_step_record: The engineer completes the checklist; the condition, the inspection and the activity log follow.
condition_score_2_description: Ageing has started here and there.
condition_score_5_description: Ageing is clear and getting worse.
condition_legend_scale_note: A condition's score comes from its defects by NEN 2767's method: each defect's severity and intensity give its category, the extents of one category add up, and the points of all categories give the score; a unit with defects on its components takes the worst element. One without defects is 1.
condition_critical_from_description: A unit with this condition or worse is critical, as is one whose inspection has expired. 5 is Poor.
condition_attention_from_description: A unit with this condition or worse needs attention. 4 is Moderate.
condition_photo_too_large: A photo may be at most {size}.
condition_photo_not_image: That isn't a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
condition_point_closed: The checklist can't be changed any more.
